structured_output.content: The change patches the forked ACME package in cert-manager to support the ACME profiles extension. It is listed under "Other (Cleanup or Flake)", and the excerpt does not describe any behaviour change, new default or required action. The environment summary shows a cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate and cert-manager v1.17.0 installs, but the installed CRDs list shows only certificates.cert-manager.io, so it cannot be seen whether any ACME Issuer or ClusterIssuer is in use. Missing: whether the operator uses ACME issuers, and whether the release notes describe user-visible effects of the profiles support.
